name: ABS Building Approvals Latest Release (XLSX)
notes: ABS time-series workbook with metadata rows before its table headers. Exercises worksheet header discovery and wide-table pivoting.

name: NSW Dwelling Completions (XLSX)
notes: NSW Government wide-format workbook. Imports as 36 period rows and auto-renders a three-series line chart.

name: SA Suburb Boundaries (CSV export)
notes: Resolved from the supplied SA resource page. Imports the first 1,000 rows, with suburb, postcode, and geometry-area fields. The supplied portal page itself is intentionally rejected as HTML.

name: Queensland Office of the Governor Consultancies 2023–24 (CSV export)
notes: Resolved from the supplied Queensland resource page. Small CSV with provider names, reporting period, and expenditure; imports as four rows.

name: Victorian Smart City Asset Installations (CSV export)
notes: Resolved from the supplied DataVic resource page. Includes installation dates and latitude/longitude; auto-renders as a scatter plot.

name: ABS SEIFA 2021 Local Government Area Indexes (XLSX)
notes: A focused workbook selected from the supplied ABS release page. Exercises ABS workbook metadata/header handling; browser access may require downloading and using Upload if ABS blocks CORS.

name: ACT Road Crash Data (Socrata CSV export)
notes: Resolved from the supplied ACT visualisation portal. Imports the first 1,000 crash records and auto-renders longitude/latitude as a scatter plot.

name: Global Palmer Penguins (CSV, benchmark scatter data)
notes: Benchmark dataset with species/island categories and bill, flipper, and mass measures. Imports 344 rows; blank values remain missing rather than becoming zeroes.

name: Global Volcanic Eruptions (CSV, Tidy Tuesday)
notes: 958 volcano records with country/type fields and latitude/longitude/elevation. Auto-renders a coordinate scatter chart.

name: Australian Postcodes & Spatial Coordinates (CSV)
notes: High-cardinality Australian location data with postcode, locality, state, and coordinates. Imports the first 1,000 rows and auto-renders a scatter chart.

name: Global Gapminder Development Data (CSV)
notes: The supplied gh-pages URL now returns 404; this is its current main-branch location. Tests country/year series with population, life expectancy, and GDP per capita.

name: Johns Hopkins Global COVID-19 Time Series (CSV)
notes: Extremely wide country time series. The parser detects date columns after the province/country/latitude/longitude metadata and pivots them into a proper period-based chart.

name: City of Melbourne Street Addresses (CSV, OpenDataSoft API export)
notes: Large spatial/address dataset containing geo_point_2d (lat/long) and geo_shape. Tests location-field heuristics and performance on higher row volumes.

name: Ballarat Air Temperature Observations (CSV, semicolon-delimited URL)
notes: Continuous environmental readings. Tests timestamp parsing across fine-grained interval observations and floating-point numeric extraction.

name: WA public school locations (XLSX, lat/long)
notes: Real-world spatial dataset with lat/long plus enrolment counts; auto-selects scatter on Latitude/Longitude.

name: International student enrolments by ABS SA4 (extension-less XLSX URL)
notes: URL has no .xlsx extension (ends in /xlsx, not .xlsx); exercises the ZIP-signature sniff fallback in parse(). Commencements is typed categorical because low counts are masked as '<5' text in the source.

name: NDIS Commission compliance actions (CSV, no real numeric metric)
notes: Only numeric columns are ABN and Postcode (both id-like); guess() should fall back to a count-of-rows bar chart rather than charting ABN/Postcode as a metric.
